---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/publication_artifacts.R"))
begin_artifact_render("clin_effect_table_s3")
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03"),
  funs = c("dag_helpers", "assoc_tests", "cox_extract", "tlr_landmark",
           "dag_association_tests", "supp_table_labels", "supp_table_s3"),
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "dagitty", "survival",
               "coxphf", "logistf", "coin"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)

# The conditional independencies are derived from the canonical `dag` object
# (dag_helpers.R) by dag_association_tests.R (issues #155, #170).
dd <- prepare_dag_data(data, landmark = "week9")
```

```{r run-tests, include=FALSE}
ci_results <- run_dag_ci_tests(dag, dd, seed = analysis_seed)
em_results <- run_dag_effect_modification_tests(dag, dd)

s3 <- build_supp_table_s3(ci_results, em_results, dd)
n_omitted <- sum(s3$raw$Section == SUPP_S3_OMITTED_SECTION)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(s3$table[, names(s3$table) != "Section"],
      caption = "Table S3. Conditional independence assessments",
      format = "html", row.names = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) |>
  pack_rows(supp_label(SUPP_S3_OMITTED_SECTION),
            nrow(s3$table) - n_omitted + 1, nrow(s3$table)) |>
  footnote(general = s3$footnotes, general_title = "Notes: ")
```

```{r save-csv, include=FALSE}
write_artifact_csv(s3$table, file = here("outputs", "tables", "clin_effect_table_s3.csv"),
                   row.names = FALSE)
write_artifact_csv(s3$raw, file = here("outputs", "tables", "clin_effect_table_s3_raw.csv"),
                   row.names = FALSE)
```

Table saved to `outputs/tables/clin_effect_table_s3.csv`; unformatted values (estimates, intervals, p-values, check flags) in `outputs/tables/clin_effect_table_s3_raw.csv`.

```{r artifact-manifest, include=FALSE}
finish_artifact_render()
```
